message: beads-superpowers hard-depends on great_cto; five-stage Fable-plans/Opus-implements pipeline; bd+mex are the plan of record; tier gates are tooling — see docs/decisions/ADR-0061-great-cto-hard-dependency-pipeline.md

cv6's remaining P1s are finished by direct implementation, not implementing-epics: that skill requires an initiative bead and metadata.plan_path, cv6 has neither because it is the epic that built the machine, and the skill's own rule sends such an epic to the pre-rework path

cv6.20 (variant-suffixed model ids brick a session) ships the message half only for 0.18.0: the guard's deny now carries the reason and remedy; normalise-on-record vs listing variants in great_cto's tier-map is deferred to a planning pass

Enforcement ships with disclosure: cn3's README wording claims the installer stops without the great_cto bundle root, so install.sh gained check_great_cto rather than leaving the README making a false claim

tier-gate treats a session_effort of 'default' as unconstrained, the same as an absent key, because no session ever reports that literal — widening cv6.15 past its acceptance criteria, which the bead description already named

Cut beads-superpowers v0.18.0 on 2026-08-20 paired with great_cto 3.1.0 (ADR-0061 spec D1 ordering: great_cto released and installed first, then the bsp tag and Release). The epic cv6 stays open with 13 P2/P3 children deferred to 0.18.1 rather than being closed on the release milestone.

OSS survey 2026-08-20: no adoptable guided harness exists — frameworks own the agent loop, agent libraries enforce nothing, Agent OS retired its role registry (v2.1.0, 2025-10-21); type-keyed authority is built as our own data table compiled onto native harness enforcement (Claude Code agent_type hook payloads; OpenCode per-agent permission blocks)

Claude Code PreToolUse payloads carry agent_type/agent_id but never model, and hooks fail open (only exit 2 blocks; exit 1 and command-hook timeouts proceed) — a redesigned guard keys on agent_type and must invert to fail-closed in our own shim; no external policy engine can supply that guarantee

Plugin-distributed Claude Code subagents ignore permissionMode/hooks/mcpServers frontmatter — type enforcement for the plugin channel lives in plugin hooks.json, with per-agent tools/disallowedTools as defence-in-depth; per-type model/effort is cost economy, never the deny surface

Retired the session-model tier wall (owner-directed): no gate/hook reads session model/size/effort. tier-gate.sh --stage is now an install preflight; pipeline-guard = install integrity + Rule D + new Rule S keyed on payload agent_id — subagents cannot mutate beads (reads + bd note excepted), write mex, or edit the plan of record; orchestrating session unrestricted. tier-map.json stays as dispatch economy. Basis: .internal/research/2026-08-20-agent-type-authority-oss-harness-survey.md

Pipeline UX: user never fires pipeline scripts — workflows do. tier-gate.sh --phase (agent-run, advisory) reports current phase + next: routing line; getting-up-to-speed carries it into orientation. phase:/next: prefixes are the only output contract.

Ship the great_cto 3.2.0 / beads-superpowers 0.19.0 pair: released 0.18.0's pipeline-guard called resolve_session_tier, which the agent-authority rework deleted from bundle-root.sh, so a 0.18.0 plugin cache against a post-rework install root denied every Bash/Write/Edit call. Releasing both halves is what re-pairs them.

pipeline-guard compares its own package.json version against the integrity record's before sourcing the attested bundle-root.sh, and denies a mismatch with both versions plus the refresh command — replacing an unactionable 'command not found'. Stands down when either side has no version; a git checkout is exempt, because the documented maintainer workflow symlinks the plugin cache at the dev repo and is meant to run ahead.

GREAT_CTO_MIN_VERSION raised 3.1.0 -> 3.2.0: below it great_cto's lifecycle skills still route on tier-gate.sh --assert and the exit-4 SKIP, both removed by the rework, so an older bundle hands an agent a flag that no longer exists.

great_cto's GitHub lineage was reconciled by force-push (owner-approved): origin/main held 31 commits from an abandoned 2026-08-06 architecture generation, and the published v3.1.0 release pointed at that lineage's a04d373a rather than the rework commit 17630dea — so beads-superpowers 0.18.0's 'great_cto >= 3.1.0' floor was publicly satisfiable by a bundle containing none of the rework. Local main (295 commits) is now canonical; the displaced commits are preserved at branch archive/lineage-2026-08-06.

Made an epic dispatchable by creating a new minimal initiative (beads-superpowers-myj) + epic (myj.1) over 5 re-parented open tasks, rather than repairing the cv6 subtree in place — graph-lint judges all transitive descendants including closed ones, so in-place repair would have stamped 22 closed task beads for no dispatch benefit.

graph-lint check 8 rejects non-epic/task initiative members as a HARD ERROR, but exempts members whose status is closed (2026-08-22 maintainer ruling, epic beads-superpowers-myj.1). Rationale: bd ready --parent <epic> -t task never lists a chore, so an OPEN chore under an epic looks planned but can never dispatch; that argument cannot apply to a CLOSED one. Rejected alternatives: gating the reject on --require-stamps, and downgrading it to a non-fatal report — both would let an open chore added post-capture pass silently. This is a BREAKING change for graphs that pass today; disclosure tracked as beads-superpowers-ra6.

pipeline-guard Rules D and S keep their command-TEXT matching unchanged, over-match and all (2026-08-22 maintainer ruling). A read, or a bare mention of a protected string inside a quoted pattern, is denied even though nothing protected is touched. Rationale: parsing intent out of a Bash command string is where matchers get bypassed, so fail-closed is preferred. Observed cost is higher than the ruling assumed — it blocked the controller storing a review report and killed two epic reviewers mid-review — so the remedy is documentation and better deny-message text (beads-superpowers-fpi, -9q1), never a narrowed matcher.
